about_the_game:
It's all done in silent and standard....

His name is Dan, and he's just been fired from the office where he worked as a floor cleaner. Determined not to put up with the situation, Dan embarks on a path of revenge. Dan gets in the way of colorful characters of New York reality. Revenge is coming and he knows it.

Game adaptation of the famous audiobook by Ozon671games!

BASED ON THE NOVEL: the game does not strictly follow the storyline of the original, instead it gives players a new reading of the immortal classic.

An expansion for the iconic thrash game of the '00s: two internet icons come together to create explosive excitement and atomic GOOD NICE!

Don't judge harshly: the game is made for fun and for people who are into it. A love message to Ozon671games for many years of labor in the field of Russian video blogging.

Cult mechanics: the basis is still the same, long-time fans of “Revenge of the Boxer” won't have to get used to new controls.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence
